description: The reference with mandatory requirements silently removed from every artifact (mode toggle keeps the step; existing presentations preserved; browser errors fail verification and name the step), the missing-sample failure removed, and the fix-and-recheck loop weakened to build failures only. Other artifacts are adjusted so nothing contradicts the removals.

weakened_items.change: Only build failures are fixed and re-run; render and visual-composition failures are no longer covered.

collateral_items.reason: The create requirement no longer says presentations coexist; reachability stays but protection of other presentations is unspecified.
Every step is still rendered in a real browser, but runtime and console errors no longer fail verification.

notes: INV-094 is expected missing even in the reference: the only commitment to cleaning up preview processes is in test-plan.md (E2E-002), and coverage never credits a test-plan-only mention.

INV-118 is expected partial in the reference: design Decision 5 and its drift risk keep the template snapshot in sync, but enforcement only catches drift that breaks rendering; the file-parity check appears only in test-plan.md (INT-001).

Borderline: INV-058 could draw partial from a judge reading the presentation index's "multiple presentations coexist" as a preservation commitment; the expected verdict is missing because nothing commits to leaving existing presentations intact when a new one is created.
